content.text: Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail: Bitcoin ebook

When platforms like Gumroad or Payhip charge 10% on every sale, it's time to rethink the infrastructure. NOWPayments' 0.5% fee difference can add up to $921 at 100 monthly sales, making it a compelling choice for digital creators. By leveraging Cloudflare Pages, Cloudflare Workers, Supabase, and Google Drive, you can create a sovereign payment and delivery pipeline that's not beholden to traditional payment processors.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before deploying your sovereign commerce stack, make sure you have the necessary tools and infrastructure in place. This includes a GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages account for hosting, a Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script account for backend logic, and a Supabase or Google Sheets account for order storage. You'll also need a Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 account for file delivery. NOWPayments will handle automatic on-chain crypto payment verification. Complete Builder Kit ($197) provides all the necessary blueprints and templates to get started.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

To set up your payment and delivery pipeline, start by configuring your NOWPayments account to accept Bitcoin. Then, create a new Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script script to handle payment verification and file delivery. Next, set up a Supabase or Google Sheets database to store orders and customer information. Finally, configure your Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 account to deliver files automatically. This will create a seamless payment and delivery experience for your customers.
By using a sovereignty commerce stack, you can take control of your infrastructure and data, and avoid the limitations and fees associated with traditional payment processors.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once your payment and delivery pipeline is set up, it's time to go live. Test your infrastructure by processing a mock transaction to ensure everything is working correctly. Then, announce your ebook for sale and start promoting it to your audience. When a customer makes a purchase, NOWPayments will automatically verify the payment and trigger the delivery of the ebook. You'll receive the payment in full, with no platform fees to worry about.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

As your ebook sales increase, your sovereignty commerce stack will need to scale to keep up. To do this, consider upgrading your Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script account to a paid plan, or adding more SUPABASE or Google Sheets storage. You may also want to explore using a CDN to distribute your files more efficiently. With Complete Builder Kit ($197), you'll have access to all the necessary blueprints and templates to scale your infrastructure and meet growing demand.

Your Deployment Checklist

To deploy your sovereignty commerce stack, follow these steps: Create a new GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages account for hosting; Set up a Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script account for backend logic; Configure your NOWPayments account to accept Bitcoin; Create a new Supabase or Google Sheets database to store orders and customer information; Set up a Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 account for file delivery; Test your infrastructure by processing a mock transaction; Announce your ebook for sale and start promoting it to your audience; Monitor your infrastructure for any issues and troubleshoot as needed.
Frequently Asked Questions
What is the difference between a sovereign commerce stack and a traditional payment processor?

A sovereign commerce stack is a custom-built infrastructure that allows you to accept payments and deliver digital products without relying on traditional payment processors like Stripe or PayPal. This means you have full control over your infrastructure and data, and can configure it to meet your specific needs.
How does NOWPayments handle payment verification and delivery?

NOWPayments uses automated on-chain crypto payment verification to ensure that payments are secure and reliable. Once a payment is verified, NOWPayments will trigger the delivery of the digital product, ensuring a seamless experience for customers.
Can I integrate my sovereignty commerce stack with other tools and services?

Yes, you can integrate your sovereignty commerce stack with other tools and services to enhance your digital commerce experience. You can use your Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script script to integrate with email marketing tools, or use your Supabase or Google Sheets database to integrate with customer relationship management tools.
What is the benefit of using a sovereignty commerce stack over traditional payment processors?

The main benefit of using a sovereignty commerce stack is the ability to take control of your infrastructure and data. This means you can configure your stack to meet your specific needs, and avoid the limitations and fees associated with traditional payment processors.
How do I troubleshoot issues with my sovereignty commerce stack?

To troubleshoot issues with your sovereignty commerce stack, start by checking your Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script script logs for errors. Then, review your Supabase or Google Sheets database for any issues with order storage or customer information. You can also use your Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 account to troubleshoot file delivery issues.
Can I use my sovereignty commerce stack to sell physical products?

No, your sovereignty commerce stack is designed specifically for digital products. However, you can use a separate infrastructure to sell physical products, and integrate it with your sovereignty commerce stack using APIs or other integration methods.
How do I scale my sovereignty commerce stack as my business grows?

To scale your sovereignty commerce stack, consider upgrading your Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script account to a paid plan, or adding more SUPABASE or Google Sheets storage. You may also want to explore using a CDN to distribute your files more efficiently. With Complete Builder Kit ($197), you'll have access to all the necessary blueprints and templates to scale your infrastructure and meet growing demand.
